races.display_title: Matchbook 50,000 Graduation Series Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: APACHE PEAK ran to a decent level in bumpers after chasing home the useful Minella Yoga in a hurdle at Fairyhouse at this time last year and is taken to make a successful return to hurdles. Fiveandahalf is another who switched to bumpers after a promising hurdle debut, in his case winning at Ballinrobe in the spring, and he's feared most ahead of Gordon Elliott's Thinkitdontjinxit . APACHE PEAK (IRE) FIVEANDAHALF (IRE) THINKITDONTJINXIT (IRE)

races.display_title: Matchbook Betting Exchange Mares Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: THE DOTSKI showed improved form when off the mark at Ballinrobe last month, seeing her race out much more strongly away from heavy ground, and this lightly raced mare can make a winning handicap debut with further progress likely. Fraher Field is feared most after beating 17 rivals on her handicap debut at Listowel despite a 4 lb rise, while Cleopatra's Needle is also respected. THE DOTSKI (IRE) FRAHER FIELD (IRE) CLEOPATRA'S NEEDLE (IRE)

races.display_title: Matchbook Betting Exchange Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: WONDERFUL EVERYDAY is progressing nicely over hurdles and carried that improvement into handicaps when third despite meeting trouble at Listowel last time, so she can do better again. Boo Radley deservedly got off the mark at Kilbeggan in September and looks the chief threat to his stablemate with further progress likely. Harpy Eagle is holding his form well and should be on the premises again, along with Avalo . WONDERFUL EVERYDAY (IRE) BOO RADLEY (IRE) HARPY EAGLE (IRE)

races.verdict: GORGEOUS TOM is a consistent sort who shaped well when third in the Galway Plate in July and looks to have found a good opportunity to gain a first chase win since graduating from novice company. races.display_title: Matchbook Betting Exchange (Q.R.) Handicap Chase
races.verdict: WESTERN MODEL won over hurdles in July before running well when second at Downpatrick last month and is likely better than his third at Sligo suggests 2 weeks ago. He makes plenty of appeal at a course he's gone well at previously. Harbour Highway shaped as if ahead of his mark at Listowel and the drop back in trip rates a plus in a switch of headgear. Aurea Fortuna should be fitter after his recent fourth. WESTERN MODEL (IRE) HARBOUR HIGHWAY (IRE) AUREA FORTUNA (IRE)

races.display_title: Ethical Packaging Novices' Handicap Chase
races.verdict: ROI DU ROUME has a basement mark to exploit in this sphere and had excuses on the back of a serious error when fourth at Perth on his most recent start in September. He likely remains with a bigger effort in his locker, not least now stepping back up in trip and can put his assured fitness to good use. Chase debutants Tell The Tale and My Own Lovely Lee are others to factor in, with Wannabe and The Magus others likely players if ready to roll on their respective returns to action. races.verdict: IL EST FRANCAIS looked one with serious problems last season but this former high-class chaser starts off the new campaign on a potentially lenient mark on his first run for the Skeltons. The one-time smart Crebilly has already started his revival so is second choice, with Saint Segal also respected back at a realistic level. IL EST FRANCAIS (FR) CREBILLY (IRE) SAINT SEGAL (FR)

races.verdict: KNIGHTS CHARGE ran a cracker when narrowly denied on his handicap bow at Doncaster last month, forced to wait for a gap before quickening, and this lightly-raced colt returns to the C&D where he won in May. races.verdict: GUNFIGHTER notched his fourth all-weather success over C&D last month and with his subsequent third easy to put a line through, John Butler's 5-y-o remains firmly of interest. Of the rest, the returning Hitched could have a say from this sort of mark provided he's ready to roll. GUNFIGHTER (IRE) PORT ROAD (USA) HITCHED (IRE)

races.display_title: Juddmonte EBF Novice Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Having been sent off a well-backed favourite on debut, KEITHAAR went through the race as if to justify that confidence only to find a fellow debutant too strong. With improvement on the cards, Marco Botti's filly earns the vote to open her account at the expense of You're Sensational , who also shaped well first time up when fifth at Yarmouth last month. Iris Olivia and Speed Nation can fight it out for third. KEITHAAR (IRE) YOU'RE SENSATIONAL IRIS OLIVIA (IRE)

races.verdict: Course winner MARENGO STORM had excuses on account of the underfoot conditions at Goodwood 5 weeks ago and, boasting a positive profile prior to that, he's well worth another chance from a handy draw back on all-weather. races.verdict: Cases can be made for several, but it could be worth chancing FAST TRACK HARRY , who is well treated on early-season all-weather form and Clive Cox's 4-y-o is ideally drawn to attack. Augustus Gloop has got his career firmly back on track lately and looks a big threat along with Art Lover . FAST TRACK HARRY AUGUSTUS GLOOP ART LOVER (IRE)
